mj.faq.title: Before you choose
mj.faq.q1: Are your perfumes and oud oils authentic?
mj.faq.q1_a: Every bottle comes from our own workshop or directly from the house that made it, sealed, with its batch number.
mj.faq.q2: How long does the scent last?
mj.faq.q2_a: Our oils and extraits hold eight to twelve hours on skin and longer on fabric. Each product page shows its longevity.
mj.faq.q3_a: Orders ship within one working day. Delivery takes two to four days inside the Kingdom and three to six across the GCC.
mj.faq.q4_a: Sealed products can be returned within 14 days. Opened bottles can be exchanged if they arrive damaged.
mj.faq.q5_a: Yes. Choose gift wrap at checkout and add a message; we write it by hand on our card.
